section.title: Dock browser
section.subtitle: Drives the browser in the desktop dock (your persistent signed-in session, not a throwaway Chrome)
field.lookWithoutApproval.label: Look at the dock browser without approval
field.lookWithoutApproval.help: Once on, the “take a look” tools (list views, snapshot, screenshot, console and network, wait for text) stop raising an approval card each time. Note it looks at **the browser you are signed in to**, so pages may hold sessions and private content — turn it on only when you need it. Clicking, typing and evaluating still ask every time.
field.about.label: Note
field.about.text: This switch only decides whether the “look” tools are registered; acting tools always ask every time.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
